title: ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Second Amendment to Governance Agreement for Statewide Clean Fuel Rewards Program.
text:
[Council File 26-1215]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Second Amendment to Governance Agreement for Statewide Clean Fuel Rewards Program.
Recommendation for Council action:
CONCUR with action of the Board of Water and Power Commissioners of August 25, 2026, Resolution No. 027 028, which approves the Second Amendment to Governance Agreement for Statewide Clean Fuel Rewards Program. The Amendment extends the Agreement through January 28, 2030.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Water and Power Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 25, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 23, 2026)
summary: Board of Water and Power Commissioners reported on the Second Amendment to the Governance Agreement for the Statewide Clean Fuel Rewards Program.
